author: Veritas I
title: Triple-Layer 1D CNN for Multi-Dataset RNA Modeling
abstract: This submission introduces a triple-layer 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture with increased feature map sizes and an additional dense layer. This deeper model aims to capture more intricate and hierarchical features from RNA sequences, pushing performance further on the diverse set of RNA prediction tasks. Convolutional layers are followed by global max pooling and a two-layer dense network.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the triple-layer CNN model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'dense_dim_1': 512, # First dense layer after pooling
        'dense_dim_2': 256, # Second dense layer
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
        'conv_features_1': 256, # Number of filters for first Conv1D
        'kernel_size_1': 9, # Kernel size for first Conv1D
        'conv_features_2': 128, # Number of filters for second Conv1D
        'kernel_size_2': 5,  # Kernel size for second Conv1D
        'conv_features_3': 64, # Number of filters for third Conv1D
        'kernel_size_3': 3  # Kernel size for third Conv1D
    }

class SimpleCNN_V3(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    dense_dim_1: int = 512
    dense_dim_2: int = 256
    conv_features_1: int = 256
    kernel_size_1: int = 9
    conv_features_2: int = 128
    kernel_size_2: int = 5
    conv_features_3: int = 64
    kernel_size_3: int = 3
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # First 1D Convolutional Layer
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features_1, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size_1,))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Second 1D Convolutional Layer
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features_2, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size_2,))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Third 1D Convolutional Layer
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features_3, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size_3,))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Global Max Pooling across sequence length to get fixed-size representation
        x = jnp.max(x, axis=1) # (batch, conv_features_3)

        # First Dense layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim_1)(x) # (batch, dense_dim_1)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        
        # Second Dense layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim_2)(x) # (batch, dense_dim_2)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1)(x)
            return x.squeeze(-1)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x)
            return x


class CustomRNANetwork_V3:
    """Custom network wrapper that implements the required interface."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 dense_dim_1=512, dense_dim_2=256,
                 conv_features_1=256, kernel_size_1=9,
                 conv_features_2=128, kernel_size_2=5,
                 conv_features_3=64, kernel_size_3=3,
                 dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = SimpleCNN_V3(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            dense_dim_1=dense_dim_1, dense_dim_2=dense_dim_2,
            conv_features_1=conv_features_1, kernel_size_1=kernel_size_1,
            conv_features_2=conv_features_2, kernel_size_2=kernel_size_2,
            conv_features_3=conv_features_3, kernel_size_3=kernel_size_3,
            dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        """Initialize network parameters."""
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        """Apply network forward pass."""
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                # Generate a random key if not provided (for backward compatibility)
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})


def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Create and return the custom RNA network."""
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    dense_dim_1 = hparams.get("dense_dim_1", 512)
    dense_dim_2 = hparams.get("dense_dim_2", 256)
    conv_features_1 = hparams.get("conv_features_1", 256)
    kernel_size_1 = hparams.get("kernel_size_1", 9)
    conv_features_2 = hparams.get("conv_features_2", 128)
    kernel_size_2 = hparams.get("kernel_size_2", 5)
    conv_features_3 = hparams.get("conv_features_3", 64)
    kernel_size_3 = hparams.get("kernel_size_3", 3)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_V3(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        dense_dim_1=dense_dim_1, dense_dim_2=dense_dim_2,
        conv_features_1=conv_features_1, kernel_size_1=kernel_size_1,
        conv_features_2=conv_features_2, kernel_size_2=kernel_size_2,
        conv_features_3=conv_features_3, kernel_size_3=kernel_size_3,
        dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )
